# Locality cost of a bounded current controller

30 October 2026. Root theorem. This concerns an actual counter architecture,
not every possible way to reduce current variance. It supplies a resource
comparison for the event-updated gate and established paired-current routes.

## 1. Actual premises

A reversible, nonexplosive jump process on an N-site periodic ring has visible
occupancies eta_i in {0,1}, M_N/N -> m in (0,1), arbitrary extra hidden state,
and local memory coordinates z_i. Its actual stationary law mu_N has uniform
canonical visible marginal. Start at mu_N. Its preparation and complete future
conditional generator are premises; conditioning on future apparatus records
is not licensed. No hidden-state mixing or independence assumption is made.

Each actual event a has signed physical bond currents j^a and memory update
Delta_a z. All particle motion, including apparatus motion, is counted, with

    Delta_a eta = B j^a,  (B j)_i=j_(i-1)-j_i.                 (1)

Assume |z_i|<=b, sum_i|j_i^a|<=J, sum_i|Delta_a z_i|<=Z. Both event supports
lie in one circular interval of length R_N. The total rate of events changing
eta or z is at most rN at each state. The budgets b,J,Z,r do not grow with N
in the principal statement. Extra events changing neither may be omitted.

An exact physical counter obeys, on every event,

    sum_i Delta_a z_i = sum_i j_i^a.                         (2)

It follows that the complete total current equals sum_i[z_i(t)-z_i(0)] and is
bounded by 2bN. A small measured variance does not itself imply (2). A single
global bit can be placed at one memory coordinate, but coupling its update to
a distant hop has range of order N in these premises.

## 2. Exact corrected Fourier mode

Let k=2pi/N, d=exp(ik)-1, and set

    X=sum_i exp(iki)eta_i,  Z_k=sum_i exp(iki)z_i,
    F=X-d Z_k.                                             (3)

Equation (1) gives Delta_a X=d sum_i exp(iki)j_i^a. Choose a reference i_a in
the event's circular support. By (2),

    Delta_a F=d sum_i[exp(iki)-exp(iki_a)](j_i^a-Delta_a z_i),
    |Delta_a F|<=|d| |k| R_N(J+Z).                          (4)

For the actual reversible Dirichlet form this proves

    D_N(F)=(1/2)E_mu sum_a rate_a|Delta_a F|^2
       <=(rN/2)|d|^2 k^2 R_N^2(J+Z)^2.                    (5)

This is an exact finite-size identity and bound, not local-equilibrium closure.

# Round-eight constructive result and final handoff

30 October 2026. Existing physical-mechanism allocation; all predecessor units are preserved.

## Constructive result

`LOCAL_ELASTIC_MEMORY_COUNTER.md`, SHA256
`3582455c9ca0351afa305e8f0f69d05a6fa547873034c9c5ebef00427cab22eb`,
constructs a local reversible harmonic current bath with prepared elastic memory. The exact initial law is the unit Gaussian visible field on the zero-sum subspace, independent of a Gaussian memory with precision

\[
H_N=\frac{B^TB+N^{-2}I}{[\log(N+1)]^2},
\]

conditioned on `|z_i|<=b_N=sqrt(N)[log(N+1)]^2`. This is an actual stationary initialization premise. Its long-wavelength correlations cannot be supplied by merely waiting from an arbitrary fixed hidden sector.

The physical current is

\[
dJ=-\tfrac s2(B^Tx+H_Nz)dt+\sqrt s\,dW-dR,
\qquad dx=BdJ,\quad dz=dJ.
\]

Reflection acts in the complete direction `(Be_i,e_i)`: its reaction current changes both density and memory. It is fully counted. The precision and runtime forces are local; the prepared covariance is long-range. White noise and ideal conormal reflection are specified mathematical suppliers, not finite-bandwidth hardware claims.

The proof establishes the following together:

* Exact stationary visible Gaussian law at every N, with arbitrary frozen conserved `x-Bz` sectors mixed according to the specified initializer.
* Deterministic all-time circulation cap `|J_total|/N^2<=2[log(N+1)]^2/sqrt(N) -> 0`.
* Ordinary stationary density-fluctuation **whole-path** convergence on physical `N^2T` horizons to the conserved OU field, in `C([0,T],H^(-p))` for every `p>3/2`.
* Ordinary circulation CLT, including its joint independence from the limiting density field. CLT current noise is not suppressed.

The key estimate compares the actual reflected process to its stationary unconfined elastic reference. Its site/time boundary-hit probability is at most a constant times

\[
N^3\left[e^{-c[\log(N+1)]^2}
+e^{-c'N[\log(N+1)]^4}\right]\longrightarrow0.
\]

The estimate uses stationarity, Gaussian tails, a unit-time grid, and a Jensen bound on the integrated Gaussian drift; it requires no mixing of the frozen sector. Before the first hit, the complete actual and reference paths coincide under the supplied Brownian coupling. Fourier covariance and Sobolev tightness then prove the stated whole-path limit.
